verdict.rationale: Stripe's official hosted MCP server lets an AI agent operate the account through natural-language requests. It exposes generic read and write tools across customers, refunds, subscriptions, invoices, payment links, payouts and more, plus analytics and docs search. Documented example prompts include "What's my MRR for the last 6 months, by month?", sensitive writes go through human confirmation, and OAuth governance is in place; a probe confirms the server is live. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface inside the Dashboard itself (operation requires bringing your own agent client), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language operation works in practice.
